From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: FinLytics POC: success criteria & kickoff next steps

Jordan / Priya — thanks again for a great call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC moving: 

Recap / proposed success criteria:
- Ingest FinLytics historical event data (30 days) and return sub-second embeddings for search queries.
- Achieve mean 95th percentile query latency < 450ms for common queries during a 10 qps sustained window.
- Demonstrate coherent answer quality on 50 sample prompts (avg. human eval >= 4/5).
- Validate data isolation and audit logs per your compliance checklist.

POC scope & timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): access + sample dataset + onboarding checklist.
- Week 1: model selection & integration demo (SE-led).
- Weeks 2-3: run evaluation suite, measure latency/cost, collect qualitative feedback.
- Week 4: results review + decision meeting.

Ownership / asks: 
- FinLytics: share S3 access or sample export, list of 50 eval prompts, and primary technical contact (Priya copied).
- Redwood: Marcus will lead SE onboarding and provide the integration checklist; I’ll coordinate schedule and exec touchpoints.

Attachments: FinLytics-POC-MAP.xlsx (POC milestones & owners), redwood_poc_onboarding_checklist.pdf

Next steps (please reply with):
1) Confirm success criteria above or send tweaks.
2) Proposed date for a 60-min integration demo (Marcus + Priya).
3) Provide S3/sampled data access or an ETA for same.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick follow-up if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Priya / Jordan — quick technical checklist from the SE side to keep things moving: 

1) Data access: read-only S3 credentials (or pre-signed URLs) + sample manifest (CSV of keys).
2) Schema notes: include a small sample JSON/CSV export (10-20 rows) showing typical fields and text length distribution.
3) Security: will you require us to use your VPC connector for ingestion or is public S3 OK? Any IP allowlist?
4) Eval prompts: send the 50 sample prompts in a shared Drive link.

Suggested demo agenda (60 min):
- 10m: introductions + goals
- 25m: live integration + ingestion walkthrough
- 15m: run a few eval queries and show metrics dashboard
- 10m: next steps & timeline confirmation

If you can share access by Wed (Feb 9) we can start ingesting and schedule the demo for Feb 10 as discussed. Attaching the onboarding checklist for your infra team.
